last_result.headline: Q57 closed the state-space side of the alignment DP. Harness validated (ndip=1 reproduces Q10's 12.170 exactly; degeneracy control 0.0000000000). Every augmented arm finds strictly lower objective cost and strictly worse RMSE, monotone in dip width (cost -569.7/-624.4/-633.6, rmse 12.170/14.850/19.929), and at ndip=5 the DP is worse than the flat anchor. THE 40-WELL ACTIVATION DIAGNOSTIC CORRECTED THE SMOKE-BASED DRAFT: the dip is active on 42-46% of steps and path deviation rises 4.9 -> 21.1 ft against 36.0 ft of truth, so the augmentation DOES cure Q54's over-damping and the RMSE still degrades by up to 7.8 ft. The DP can be made to move the right amount; moving it in the wrong direction is worse than not moving. The damping was protection against an emission with no directional content, not a limitation of the transition model. Nested picks the un-augmented baseline in both folds (gain +0.000, helps 0.0%). The alignment DP is now closed on four sides -- emission, transition, decoder, state space -- and the binding constraint is located in the emission.
